message: 変態は誰だ!?
I did everything I could.
I've done all that is humanly possible; now I just await fate's decree.

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's over!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Everything is over~」

name: Eddie
message: 「Over and done with. Synn, wanna hit up karaoke for the first time in forever? Found some free passes」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, guys, this is the exact same conversation we had on day one...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hehehn. This time it's really over, y'know!」

name: Eddie
message: 「I was already done for from the start, though」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I was done for before it even started~」
I probably shouldn't ask how they did.

name: Synn
message: 「How'd it go for you, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「I filled it in」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Right...\s01」

name: Azel
message: 「Aren't we studying for the tests today?」
What is up with this rapid-fire barrage of deja vu conversations?

name: Synn
message: 「The tests are already over, so our study sessions are over too」

name: Azel
message: 「I see」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll treat you to ramen. Today's no good, so when works for you?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'll leave it up to you」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I'm definitely treating you, so look forward to it」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Azel
message: 「I heard from Lolotte. Apparently you don't have any money」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah. Don't worry about it, though」

name: Azel
message: 「You don't need to push yourself」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, a promise is a promise.」

name: Azel
message: 「...You never break yours.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're starting to understand the kind of person I am too, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「It's not like I wanted to understand.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn! Let's get ready soon!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-oh, right. You remembered.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You betcha!」

name: Azel
message: 「Get ready?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. We have a little Student Council work to do after this.」

name: Azel
message: 「I'll help.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? But Azel, you always... at times like this...」

name: Azel
message: 「I am the Student Council's secretary.」

name: Azel
message: 「Finished putting them up.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun. Is a plan like this really going to work?」

name: Synn
message: 「The best thing about you is how you still go along with it even while saying that, Misa.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just be honest with yourself, Hisu.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm only getting ready to clean up your mess!」

name: Sally
message: 「Even I'd fall for something this good. It'll be fine. Prez is a genius!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm... He looked dumb, sure, but is he really *this* dumb?」

name: Synn
message: 「He's looking for us, so he'll come.」
We stuck arrow signs reading 'The Student Council is this way' all over the academy.
If he follows the direction of the arrows, he should end up right here.
Isn't this a bit too blatant, no matter how you look at it?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Lolotte Bear will come. There is no doubt about it.」

name: Ria
message: 「That sounds like a name that'd get along really well with you, Lolotte-chan」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since I am the discoverer, I named him!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, really? That's amazing, Lolotte-chan」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please praise me lots」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He's not, though」

name: Lolotte Bear
message: 「Ha-ha-ha! I've finally found you, Student Council!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh. He actually came」

name: Misa
message: 「I can't believe it......」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. To think he'd fall for it so easily」

name: Azel
message: 「It goes beyond foolish straight into comical」

name: Lolotte Bear
message: 「Your evil-doing spree ends right here! Someone you lot once oppressed kindly told me where you were hiding. Nwah-ha-ha-ha-ha!」

name: Misa
message: 「Seeing him in the flesh, that plan makes total sense」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't think it's good to judge people by appearances, you know? Though in this case......」

name: Paqy
message: 「Trailing off like that is just Ria-chan's kindness showing」

name: Lolotte Bear
message: 「Gasp!? Could it be that Pasta-chan secretly tipped me off!? Is this hidden love!? That's gotta be it! Pasta-chan putting up signs is so moe!」

name: Lolotte Bear
message: 「Once this brawl is over, I'm gonna marry Pasta-chan!」

name: Misa
message: 「......Fighting him is starting to feel ridiculous」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't let your guard down」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He looks like a total idiot, sure, but he blew the roof off the gazebo with just his overflowing magic power」

name: Ria
message: 「He's that strong...... Don't tell me, is this person a Bylous?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No. He is a Lolotte Bear」

name: Lolotte Bear
message: 「Grrrrr. Hey, you woman over there with the needlessly huge tits! Calling the great me a Bylous is beyond rude!」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I...... get stiff shoulders easily, and my big sister is always teasing me, so I'm actually really self-conscious about them......」

name: Paqy
message: 「What an outrageous insult to Ria-chan's gorgeous breasts! That guy is definitely the enemy」

name: Synn
message: 「They've been our enemy from the start」

name: Arden
message: 「Listen up, because I'm gonna tell you my drop-dead gorgeous name! My name is Arden! By my own estimation, I'm 100 times stronger than that womanizing punk」

name: Arden
message: 「No, 1,000 times! No, 100,000 times! No, a hundred trillion times!」
A womanizer... no way.
Wait, if that Melphas guy is actually Bylous, then...
Then again, he introduced himself as Melphas, so maybe not. Though it could be a fake name.

name: Pasta
message: 「Hey! Don't talk bad about Bylous-nyama, nya!」

name: Arden
message: 「That voice... it's my beloved, sweet little Pasta-chaaaaan! Where should we have the wedding? I've collected a ton of brochures!」

name: Pasta
message: 「A conceited pedo like you doesn't even stand a chance, nya! Bylous-nyama is way, way, way, waaaay cooler than you by a mile, nya!」

name: Arden
message: 「Watch me, Pasta-chan! I'm gonna do this!」
As Arden lets out a roar, his overflowing magical power makes the air crackle and tremble.

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go too!」
Skip the battle?
